label: WRONG
reason: Every schema class (audiences.py, awards.py, tokens.py) extends ma.ModelSchema, but 'classes in CTFd/schemas/**' also covers co-located marshmallow helpers: a validate.Validator in challenges.py and a fields.Field in config.py, which can't be ModelSchemas, so new custom validators or fields would get false alarms. I hesitated with ACCEPT, since the rule holds for real schema classes.

label: ACCEPT
reason: BaseForm in forms/__init__.py wires the CTFdCSRF nonce field. Every form (auth.py, awards.py, notifications.py, config.py, and nested ones in teams.py) extends it, and nothing enforces this: ruff in pyproject.toml has no such rule. A new form built on plain wtforms.Form would drop the CSRF nonce. The only outlier is the custom SubmitField in fields.py, a field rather than a form.
